title: data/reports/<year>.json and data/reports/undated.json
description: Published report metadata for one year, or for reports with no usable date. Reports are never re-hosted: only metadata, derived IDs and links are published.

published.description: The publication date, or null when no usable date exists. A dated report sits in the shard for its year, an undated one in reports/undated.json.

organisation.description: The publishing organisation, or null when no source names it.

url_ok.description: The last link check on url. False means it failed, so the site shows archive_url first. Null means not checked yet, or there is no url.

archive_url.description: An archived copy held by a source, or null.

actors.description: Resolved actors the report is tagged with, including those in actors_from_title.

actors_from_title.description: The subset of actors that a source's title names and no tag confirms. A link-only source's post is never read, so this is the title's word and nothing else.

actor_names_unresolved.description: Actor names a publishable source gave for the report that did not resolve to exactly one actor, verbatim. Link-only sources add none, and ORKL's own actor tags are never listed here.

cves.description: CVE IDs found in the report.

techniques.description: ATT&CK technique IDs found in the report.

dateBasis.description: Where published came from. malpedia-library: Malpedia's library entry for the URL. title-date: the filing date at the start of the title, used when it is no later than the ORKL ingest date. file-metadata: the document's creation date. orkl-ingest: the date ORKL added the report, a last resort. publisher: the publisher's own feed. paper: the paper's dataset. unknown: no usable date, and published is null.

actorId.description: An ATT&CK group ID such as G0007, or a lower-case ASCII slug for an actor ATT&CK does not track. The ID is also the actor's file name and URL segment, so it has no colons, slashes or spaces, and it is never 'index'.

cve.description: A CVE ID in upper case.

label.description: Non-empty text with no leading or trailing whitespace and no line breaks.

nullableDate.description: A date, or null when none is known.

nullableLabel.description: A label, or null when no source gives one.

nullableUrl.description: An http or https URL, or null.

reportId.description: The report's SHA-1 in lower-case hex when one is known, otherwise <source>:<source_id>.

sourceKey.description: A connector key such as attack or misp, as listed in sources.json. Never a display name.

techniqueId.description: An ATT&CK technique or sub-technique ID.
